title: Independently verify PR2942 joint helper restoration
body:
PR2942's proposed recursive saving depends on its four paired helper extractions remaining valid together. This adds an independent check of the simultaneous word: both providers pass every coefficient over 632 arbitrary original inputs, all 86 restored dirty-helper rows/columns, ordered compensation and complete inverse cleanup, in forward and inverse-transpose orientations. A separate column/covector implementation checks all four stages and the 5,980-term compensation map without importing predecessor checkers. No construction defect was found in this finite scope.

A defect-sensitive control shows why forward verification alone is insufficient: deleting the first cleanup gate still passes the complete forward clean-buffer replay, but inverse-transpose return leaves coefficient -1 from original input2 in private register969. The valid word contains the gate and passes both. The package includes a written block-matrix explanation, exact witnesses, 20 rejecting controls across both implementations, and equivalent-presentation positive controls.

Validation: registered CPython3.12.12 replay; ordinary/optimized output equality; identical read-only Git-free CPython3.14.6 replay; authenticated original author input blobs; exact committed-byte preflight. Hosted CI is separate. Private buffers must start zero. Native phases, actual frame/owner/stock/precision admission, complete recursive/outer costs and inherited all-size assumptions remain outside this audit; no new kappa or formal-kernel/human proof claim.

Scientific base:6e1bbb4a489cb7d05bf592a043d5d353eb767e4a. Source PR2942:a027b0f6fdb0ab2b42ba10fc31b53960166bf2bf; parent PR2917:224bd5e56041c40078ff6b5fa7393733a215de5c. Pre-submission main9d76996a has unchanged guidance, priority5 and selected record. Archived predecessor merges are not treated as mathematical endorsement. This complements PR2932's frame-ledger audit and PR2952's retiming boundary.

Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean/2942, Mason Hale/2917, Jeremy Diviney/2908, Jeremy Kothe/2894/2833, Yiyang Lu, Dugongue, Tekalign, icekylinx and retained lineage. Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and a separate AI mathematical check; Apache-2.0.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18975117). Only research/normal45-joint-restoration is added; no shared tooling or frontier records change.
